fixed.member: ui screens (calendar, notifications, pagination, star-rating, tree)
fixed.summary: Moves frames: their `<og-icon>`s draw their glyphs. They named the glyph with `name=`, which on an `<og-icon>` element is what a screen reader calls it (only an icon inline in text takes its glyph from `name`), so the previous and next chevrons, the close cross, the stars and the tree's twisty drew nothing and were announced as "chevronLeft" and the like. They now write `icon=`; each button keeps its own `aria-label`.
